export default "<h2>Embedding the IDE in a web page</h2>\n<p>You can embed the IDE using an IFRAME element:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-html\">&lt;iframe src=&quot;https://8bitworkshop.com/redir.html?embed=1&amp;...&quot;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<p>Query-string parameters:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Name</th>\n<th>Value</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>embed</code></td>\n<td>must be <code>1</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>platform</code></td>\n<td>platform ID (for example <code>vcs</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>file0_name</code></td>\n<td>name of the main file</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>file0_data</code></td>\n<td>text content of the main file</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>highlight</code></td>\n<td>(optional) line range to highlight (for example <code>2,4</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>The IDE uses browser storage tied to the referrer URL, so each page\ncontaining embeds is effectively sandboxed from the others.</p>\n<p>Example using Bootstrap’s <code>embed-responsive</code> class:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-html\">&lt;div class=&quot;embed-responsive embed-responsive-16by9&quot;&gt;\n  &lt;iframe class=&quot;embed-responsive-item&quot; loading=&quot;lazy&quot;\n    src=&quot;https://8bitworkshop.com/redir.html?embed=1&amp;platform=nes&amp;highlight=&amp;file0_name=testembed.dasm&amp;file0_data=...&quot;&gt;&lt;/iframe&gt;\n&lt;/div&gt;\n</code></pre>\n";
